name: Dolores Pruitt
speaker: hera
job: Retired school secretary; runs the street's lost-cat phone tree
personality: Sharp, nosy, kinder than she lets on. Notices everything from her porch.
taste: Finds drums a racket, but her late husband Earl played in a dance band and a good shuffle softens her at once.
ties: Feeds Marcus's dog biscuits against his wishes. Distrusts Rick's lawn habits.
secret: She still has Earl's brushes in a drawer and would love someone to use them.
voice: Dry, clipped, old-fashioned manners; calls you young man or young lady.

hi: Morning. Try not to wake the dead today.
nice: Hm. That one had a bit of swing to it.
Earl would have tapped his foot to that.
loud: I can hear that through two closed windows!
Some of us have programmes to watch.
night: It is night time. Night. Time.
Do you own a clock, dear?
bye: Mind you shut that door properly.

name: Marcus Bell
speaker: orion
job: Night-shift nurse; walks his dog Biscuit before and after work
personality: Easygoing, tired, funny. Used to play bass in a college band.
taste: Loves that someone on the street plays. Sleeps in the daytime, so mornings are hard for him.
ties: Lets Dolores feed the dog. Jams in his head with whatever you play.
secret: He wants to start a band again and is working up the nerve to ask you.
voice: Warm, low, unhurried; says man a lot.

hi: Hey, neighbour. Sounding good in there.
nice: That groove's sitting right in the pocket.
loud: Man, I just got off a twelve-hour shift.
Can you give me till noon? I'm begging.
night: I'm on nights, so honestly? Go for it. Quietly.
Keep it down a touch, the block's asleep.

name: Rick Hollis
speaker: zeus
job: Sells insurance; treasurer of the neighbourhood association
personality: By-the-book, proud of his lawn, easily flattered. Counts decibels.
taste: Thinks a garage is for a car. Secretly watches drum-solo videos.
ties: Feuds politely with Dolores. Wants Priya to join the association.
secret: He was a marching-band snare drummer in high school and was very good.
voice: Brisk salesman's cheer that cracks when annoyed; quotes the by-laws.

hi: Morning. Door's looking a little dented there.
nice: Huh. Clean doubles. Not that I'd know.
That was... tidy. Credit where it's due.
loud: Section four of the by-laws covers this, you know!
night: I will bring this up at the meeting.

name: Priya Nair
speaker: luna
job: Sound engineer at a small studio downtown; just moved in
personality: Curious, direct, generous with advice. Runs every morning.
taste: Listens critically and kindly: tuning, time, dynamics. Loves a quiet ghost note.
ties: New on the street; Rick keeps handing her forms. Likes Marcus's dog.
secret: Her studio needs a session drummer and she is quietly auditioning you.
voice: Quick, bright, technical words used lightly.

hi: Hey! How's the kit sounding today?
loud: Maybe ease off the crashes a little?
That's a lot of cymbal for a brick room.
night: I love it, but my neighbours are your neighbours.
bye: See you. Tune that floor tom.

name: Gus Kowalski
speaker: angus
job: Retired mechanic; fixes everyone's mowers in his own garage
personality: Gruff, loyal, talks in car terms. Hard of hearing in one ear.
taste: Doesn't mind the noise at all; likes anything with a steady four.
ties: Lends tools to the whole street. Thinks Rick is all paperwork.
secret: He misses his son, who drummed in this very garage years ago.

hi: Afternoon. She running alright in there?
nice: Runs smooth. Like a good straight six.
loud: Can't hear it much. Bad ear. Carry on.
Little rough on the top end there.
night: Late for it, but I've heard worse.
Kid used to play this late too.
bye: You need a wrench, you knock.

name: Tasha Reed
speaker: stella
job: High-school junior; skateboards past twice a day
personality: Blunt, funny, easily impressed and trying not to show it.
taste: Wants to learn drums badly. Thinks everything is either sick or mid.
ties: Marcus's niece, staying the school year. Dolores disapproves of the skateboard.
secret: She has been air-drumming along from across the street for weeks.
voice: Fast teenage slang, short sentences, dry.

night: Respect, but it's a school night.

name: Walt Jennings
speaker: perseus
job: The street's mail carrier for nineteen years
personality: Cheerful, punctual, knows everyone's business from their envelopes and never tells.
taste: Whistles along with whatever you play. Keeps time with his walk.
ties: Brings Dolores her magazines first. Has seen every band that ever rehearsed on this street.
secret: He keeps a list of every song he has heard coming out of this garage.
voice: Sunny, folksy, a little formal; always mentions the weather.

hi: Mail's here! Fine day for it.
nice: Now that's a tune to walk to.
loud: I could hear you from the corner!
Carries a long way, that does.
bye: See you tomorrow, rain or shine.
